Class Workout

java.lang.Object
Workout
public class Workout extends Object
Workout.java Represents one workout in the Workout Tracker DMS. Each Workout holds 6 pieces of data of 4 different types: an int ID, a String exercise name, an int duration, a double body weight, a double MET value, and a boolean completed flag. This class does not check its own data. The WorkoutValidator class checks everything before a Workout object is created or changed.

    • calculateCaloriesBurned

      public double calculateCaloriesBurned()
      Custom action: estimates the calories burned during this workout. Formula: calories = MET x weight in kilograms x duration in hours. Pounds are converted to kilograms (divide by 2.20462) and minutes are converted to hours (divide by 60). Example: MET 9.8, 180 lbs, 45 minutes is about 600.1 calories.
      Returns:
      the estimated calories burned
